about: Day-type forecaster (lab/daytype.py, 2.66): at 09:45 the chance that today ends a trend day, a range day or a quiet day, for each index. Information only and on trial until the walk-forward clears 'trust'. Labels from the whole day (09:15-14:45): trend = clean move (|move since the open| / day range >= trend_eff) with a range of at least trend_rel x the typical day (median of the previous 20 days); quiet = range under quiet_rel x the typical day; range = the rest. Every candidate in 'models' is tested walk-forward by month each night; the best log-loss skill is the live one.
